title: Transport of compact-support exchange
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $u:T\to U$ a separated finite-type morphism of schemes. Let $v:U'\to U$ be arbitrary and form the Cartesian square with $T'=T\times_UU'$, $w:T'\to T$, $u':T'\to U'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Supply a compactification $c=(j,p)$ with $j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $p:\overline T\to U$ proper and $pj=u$, and its base change $c'=(j',p')$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. All coefficient sheaves are the constant discrete $\Lambda$-module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use bounded-below input complexes, ordinary uncompleted derived operations and exact open extension by zero.

Write $A_V=\nu_V^*$ for site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $l_a=a_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}$, and $a^*=a_{\mathrm{proet}}^{-1}$. Put $F_u^e=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}j_!^e$, $F_u^p=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}j_!^p$, and similarly for $u'$. Let $C_{c,L}:A_UF_u^eL\xrightarrow{\sim}F_u^pA_TL$ be the normalized proper direct-image comparison followed by the degreewise site comparison for open extension by zero [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange, lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Let $a_v:A_{U'}l_v\cong v^*A_U$ and $a_w:A_{T'}l_w\cong w^*A_T$ be the canonical comparison-pullback isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. Define
$$S_L=v^*(C_{c,L})\circ a_{v,F_u^eL},\qquad T_L=F_{u'}^p(a_{w,L})\circ C_{c',l_wL}.$$
Let $E_u^e:l_vF_u^e\to F_{u'}^el_w$ be the chosen-compactification exchange of [def-cbc-exchange-map]. Let $E_u^p:v^*F_u^p\to F_{u'}^pw^*$ be ambient pro-etale proper unit--square--counit exchange followed by open extension-by-zero base change, i.e. the same chosen-compactification composite as in [def-exchange-projection], with arbitrary $v$. Then for every $L\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$,
$$T_L\circ A_{U'}(E_u^e(L))=E_u^p(A_TL)\circ S_L.$$
This equality is natural in $L$. For an etale-origin witness $(L,\alpha:A_TL\cong N)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], transport along $\alpha$ consequently identifies the transported etale compact-support exchange at $N$ with this specified ambient pro-etale compactification composite. The identification is unchanged under an isomorphism of witnesses. No separatedness of $v$ or of the schemes over a field is assumed.
